categories.main_business_segments: Victory Giant Technology (HuiZhou) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-precision printed circuit boards (PCBs), including rigid, flexible, HDI, and rigid-flex boards. The company serves various sectors such as artificial intelligence, automotive electronics (new energy vehicles), next-generation communication technologies, data centers, industrial internet, medical instruments, computers, and aerospace. It also operates subsidiaries involved in PCB manufacturing and related electronic components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density multilayer boards, HDI, flexible circuits, and rigid-flex boards. It employs cutting-edge processes such as PCIe 6, Oak Stream platform, 800G/1.6T high-speed transmission, PTFE material application, and advanced laser drilling. The company has developed proprietary technologies for automotive electronics, AI computing cards, and high-frequency boards, supported by a digitalized smart factory integrating MES, ERP, APS, WMS, SRM, and EHR systems for efficient production and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Victory Giant serves global customers in high-tech industries including AI servers, data centers, automotive Tier 1 suppliers (e.g., Bosch, Aptiv, Continental), telecommunications, industrial robotics, medical devices, and aerospace. Its products are used in AI computing, automotive electronic control units, battery management systems, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and communication infrastructure. The company maintains long-term relationships with international leading brands and focuses on high-value, high-precision PCB applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Huizhou and subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Hunan, and other Chinese cities. It has expanded internationally with subsidiaries and manufacturing bases in Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Germany, the United States, and Japan. The company has established sales and technical support offices across the US, Europe, Japan, Taiwan, Malaysia, South Korea, Thailand, and Vietnam to serve global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Victory Giant operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of printed circuit boards. It sources raw materials such as copper-clad laminates, copper foil, and semi-cured sheets, and supplies high-precision PCB products to downstream electronics manufacturers and OEMs. The company also integrates upstream procurement and downstream sales with a comprehensive supply chain management system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation driven by AI and high-speed computing demands, focusing on developing high-layer count multilayer boards, high-frequency HDI boards, and advanced materials like PTFE. It invests heavily in R&D with over 1,300 personnel and 399 patents, targeting AI servers, automotive electronics, 5G communications, and industrial robotics. Strategic priorities include digital transformation via smart factories, green manufacturing, global capacity expansion, and intellectual property protection to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Victory Giant generates revenue primarily through product sales of printed circuit boards and related electronic components. Sales are conducted globally via direct exports and domestic sales, with a focus on high-value, customized PCB products. The company also derives income from investment returns and government subsidies but mainly relies on manufacturing and selling PCBs to international and domestic customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks 13th globally among PCB suppliers and 4th among mainland Chinese PCB manufacturers, competing with other leading PCB manufacturers worldwide. It is recognized as a high-tech enterprise and a key industry standard setter in China. Its competitive advantages lie in advanced technology, high-quality products, and strong customer relationships, particularly in AI computing and automotive electronics sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Victory Giant achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 10.73 billion, a 35.31% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.15 billion, up 71.96%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 19.18 billion, with net assets of RMB 8.93 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale. It maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to invest significantly in R&D and global expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Victory Giant differentiates itself through its high-precision, high-density PCB products tailored for cutting-edge applications in AI, automotive electronics, and telecommunications. The company emphasizes technological innovation, quality assurance, and comprehensive customer service, including a global 4S service system (Sales, Customer Service, Quality Service, Technical Service). Its smart factory and green manufacturing initiatives further enhance product reliability and sustainability, creating strong value for customers.
